example_prompts: Triage this ticket and write the first reply: "I was charged twice for my annual plan on 3 November and nobody has answered my first email."
A customer wrote: "Since this morning's update nobody on our team can sign in with SSO, we all get a 403." How urgent is it and who should handle it?
Is this a bug or a feature request? "The CSV export used to include every row, but since last week it stops at 1,000." Give me a priority, who should take it and a first reply.
Rank these three tickets and say who should handle each: (1) how do I invite a teammate, (2) all our project files vanished after last night's sync, (3) please add dark mode.
